text:
Which statement is not correct for lamps connected in parallel?
A
They can be switched on and off separately.
B
They will remain bright if another lamp is connected in parallel.
C
They share the supply voltage equally between them.
D
They still operate if one lamp is removed.

options.label: A
options.text: They can be switched on and off separately.

options.label: B
options.text: They will remain bright if another lamp is connected in parallel.

options.label: C
options.text: They share the supply voltage equally between them.

options.label: D
options.text: They still operate if one lamp is removed.
